migration.note: 0.8.0 → 0.8.1, additive: attribute sources (CA-13) and link citations; a placeholder in a required attribute now fails sdem check (LC-04). 0.8.1 → 0.9.0: a platform's network is a link (RA4-37) — a network's `connects` list becomes those links; a hosting platform on no network is a warning (LC-15); trace and impact follow networks (KG-Q-08). 0.9.0 → 0.10.0: network zones — level 0 on premises or cloud, level 1 internal or DMZ, level 2 private — hold the shapes deployed in them (RA4-38); every shape in a zone (LC-16), the structure checked (LC-17), internet-facing shapes in a DMZ (LC-18); additive. 0.10.0 → 0.11.0: hosting — cloud first by default, on premises by evidence (metamodel/hosting-signals.json); sdem aid proposes each shape's zone, marked inferred, for a person to confirm; zone connections ZC-01…ZC-04; additive. 0.11.0 → 0.12.0: an A3 interface reached from the internet is EXPOSED_THROUGH an A4 edge platform (LC-22); sdem aid proposes it, and a connection for every A4 shape linked to nothing (AID-C01…C06), for a person to decide; additive. 0.12.0 → 0.13.0: a network zone is an ArchiMate Grouping, not a network — zones nest by RA4-39; a zone carrying a network's attributes is split into the zone and its network. 0.13.0 → 0.14.0: an application BUILT_AS its artifact (sdem aid proposes it, AID-X02); additive

breaking: sdem check reads TBD, unknown, /TBD or an empty string in a required attribute as missing: an error on an active record — leave the value out and mark the record planned (LC-04)
a change-set update merges by default; give "replace": true for the whole-record replacement (AG-K08)

the link type COMPONENT_DEPLOYED_ON_INFRASTRUCTURE (deprecated in 0.15.0, metamodel 0.8.0) is removed in metamodel 0.9.0: a component DEPLOYED_ON anything but a node, device or system software is refused — re-point or supersede it before upgrading (sdem check reports each one)

deprecations.do: record each platform's network as a link — platform association network (RA4-37); sdem migrate converts the list
place the platform the component is deployed on in its network zone (RA4-38), and link the platform to its network (RA4-37) — S37 reads that route first

releases.summary: Architect experience: Home, dashboard and graph linked; graph status shown; architect tasks; sdem new --explore; the README and the Payments walkthrough rewritten. Then the improvement roadmap (metamodel 0.8.1): placeholders are missing values, natural keys for operations, attribute and link sources, evidence classes, sdem change diff, sdem handback. A platform's network is a link, and a network change reaches what runs on it (metamodel 0.9.0); network zones say where every technology shape is deployed (metamodel 0.10.0); hosting is proposed from evidence and the organisation's default, and the zones' connections are SDEM's rules (metamodel 0.11.0).

migration.note: 0.14.0 → 0.15.0: the information model (the owner's decisions D1–D8, 2026-11-16) — a data entity's fields as A3.DataAttribute records (typed, keyed), BIAN attributes typed, associations between business objects and between data entities, FIELD_MAPPED_TO, contracts that name records; additive (a design with names only is reported thin, LC-23). 0.15.0 → 0.16.0: links (D1–D9) — SERVED_BY, AUTOMATED_BY, REALIZED_BY and MAPPED_TO from A1 straight to A3 (the owner's named list, D9), IMPLEMENTED_BY a Notify operation by an event, SERVED_BY a technology service, STORED_IN; a path linked to its two ends; additive. 0.16.0 → 0.17.0: new kinds (D5) — business event, product, channel (A1) and location (A4); a business event and a channel realised by A3 (direct, D9); triggered_by, channels and an actor's location name records; a value-stream stage no longer extends a value stream; additive.

actions.do: sdem migrate --workspace <your workspace> --person <you> — 0.14.0 → 0.17.0, additive: nothing in your data changes; what is now thin is reported (LC-23 … LC-28)

releases.summary: A full design: the information model (typed fields, keys, field-level lineage), the links between and inside layers ArchiMate defines (direct A1→A3 by the owner's D9), business events, products, channels and locations; Payment Initiation v2.

migration.note: 0.17.0 → 0.18.0: stable identity — every layer and type has an id that never changes (metamodel/identity.json), the A-number is computed from the layers in use; BIAN a built-in extension (ext:bian), also its own package sdem-bian; the Data layer — data entities and their fields a layer of their own in a workspace in the 0.20 form, with ACCESSED_BY for what was access inside the Application layer. Additive: a workspace's records do not change; moving it to the 0.20 form is its own step, a person's (sdem migrate --to 0.20).

breaking: sdem new makes a workspace in the 0.20 form: layer files named by layer id (business.json, data.json, application.json, technology.json, bian.json), records that store type ids (application.ApplicationComponent), Data its own layer — a script that reads a new workspace's files by 0.19's names (a3-application.json) reads it through sdem.api (load, export_019) or makes the workspace with --form 0.19. An existing workspace keeps its form until a person migrates it.

actions.do: sdem migrate --workspace <your workspace> --person <you> — 0.17.0 → 0.18.0, version only: nothing in your data changes
